report.title: Loads - Wind Basis
report.name: PedBridgeWind
report.paragraph: GEOMETRY BASIS — Cap and wind datums derive from the selected Type F pad, 6-in pedestal and 36-in cap. Individual seat grades, separate plates, the retained wind envelope, terrain reference and gross pier-face width require final-detail confirmation.

Wind assembly module. This module gathers the bridge-level wind calculations and live results used for FB-MultiPier loading; detailed pressure and fence-resultant calculations remain in their dedicated source modules.
report.heading: 1. Wind Load Assembly
1.1. Concrete Superstructure
report.paragraph: Line load at center of concrete portion of the super structure
Strength III concrete wind pressure displayed from the main wind module.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_001_WindLoadonPedBridgeSuperstructure_P_Z_III
section.paragraph: This live reference shows the pressure already calculated from wind speed, exposure, gust treatment, and structural drag. It is force per projected area. The following line-load expression multiplies it by the concrete height exposed to wind.

report.paragraph: Strength III concrete wind force for each foot of bridge length.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_002_Wind_conc_superstrc_lineload
section.paragraph:
C001WindLoadOnPedBridgeSuperstructure.P_Z_III
is the concrete wind pressure in force per square foot. Multiply by
BridgeGeometry_2Beam.Depth_SuperStr
, the exposed concrete height, to get force per foot along the bridge. This is the perpendicular-wind reference line load before collecting the pier’s share.

report.paragraph: Total transverse concrete wind force delivered to the intermediate pier for Strength III.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_003_Wind_conc_superstrc_pointload
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.F_c_III
, where concrete pressure is multiplied by concrete depth and the pier’s contributing bridge length. This is already a complete pier force, so do not multiply it by span length again.

report.paragraph: Strength III concrete wind moment about the cap reference.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_004_Wind_conc_superstrc_moment
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.M_c_III
, the concrete pier force multiplied by its vertical offset above the cap reference. This turning effect accompanies the corresponding concrete force; it is not an additional horizontal force.

report.heading: 1.2. Fencing
report.paragraph: Uniform gross-surface fence pressure used in the separate fence calculation.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_005_q_z_fencing
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.p_fence
, the prescribed pressure applied to the complete fence outline, including mesh holes. For the global bridge-transfer model, the prescribed pressure is applied once to the gross projected fence face for the selected wind direction. The opposite wind direction is checked by reversing sign; no second simultaneous leeward 15 psf load is added.

report.paragraph: Fence midpoint height above the cap reference used for longitudinal wind.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_006_Dist_WindCG_CapCG
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.z_mid
, the fence-base height plus half the vertical fence height. This is the adopted point for the along-bridge fence force. The transverse force’s equivalent height is a different quantity obtained from its complete moment divided by its force.

report.paragraph: Strength III transverse fence force per foot of bridge from the prescribed LRFD 13.8.2 fence load.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_007_Wind_fence_lineload
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.w_fence
. The source applies the prescribed LRFD 13.8.2 pressure to the gross fence surface and expresses the resulting force per contributing bridge foot.
Use the complete simultaneous 100% transverse + 25% longitudinal row for analysis input; do not mix components or signs from different directional cases.

report.paragraph: Total Strength III transverse fence force delivered to the pier from the prescribed LRFD 13.8.2 fence load.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_008_Wind_fence_pointload
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.F_fence
. The source applies the prescribed LRFD 13.8.2 gross-surface fence load over the pier tributary length.
Use the complete simultaneous 100% transverse + 25% longitudinal row for analysis input; do not mix components or signs from different directional cases.

report.paragraph: Strength III fence moment about the longitudinal axis at the cap reference.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_009_Wind_fence_moment
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.M_fence
. The source integrates the prescribed normal pressure over the curved enclosure and carries the resulting turning effect to the cap reference.
Use the complete simultaneous 100% transverse + 25% longitudinal row for analysis input; do not mix components or signs from different directional cases.

report.heading: 1.3. Fencing and Superstructure Combined
report.paragraph: Total Strength III transverse cap force from concrete superstructure plus the prescribed fence load for the 0° reference case.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_010_Wind_CG_Cap_pointLoad
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.F_cap_T_III
. The source adds the Strength III concrete superstructure force and the prescribed LRFD 13.8.2 fence force at the same cap reference.
Use the complete simultaneous 100% transverse + 25% longitudinal row for analysis input; do not mix components or signs from different directional cases.

report.paragraph: Strength III combined moment about the longitudinal axis at the cap reference for the 0° reference case.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_011_Wind_CG_Cap_moment
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.M_cap_L_III
. The source adds the Strength III concrete superstructure moment and the prescribed LRFD 13.8.2 fence moment at the same cap reference.
Use the complete simultaneous 100% transverse + 25% longitudinal row for analysis input; do not mix components or signs from different directional cases.

report.heading: 2. Direct Pier Wind — Broad Face
report.paragraph: Strength III wind force pushing directly on the broad pier-wall face.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_012_Wind_perpPierWall
section.paragraph:
Multiply
FenceWind.p_sub_III
, the direct substructure pressure, by
BridgeGeometry_2Beam.Pier_wall_area
, the broad-face projected wall area. Pressure times area gives the wall force. It is applied directly to the pier at its wall-load location, rather than added into the bridge-and-fence cap total.

report.heading: 2.1. Pier Wall and Cap — Narrow Face
report.paragraph: Strength III force from wind acting directly on the narrow wall-and-cap face.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridgeWind_013_Wind_pierWall_pointload
section.paragraph:
Copy
FenceWind.F_wall_T_III
, which is substructure pressure times the adopted exposed height and projected cap width. Apply it at the wall-load location, with the corresponding force direction. This force is separate from wind delivered through the superstructure and fence.

report.heading: 3. Wind Load Sets
report.paragraph: Use separate Strength III and Service I wind sets with WS factor 1.0. For this qualifying usual girder bridge, the cap-reference set uses the LRFD 3.8.1.2.3a simplified components: 100% transverse plus 25% longitudinal, applied simultaneously. Apply both horizontal signs and add the direct-pier wind components separately in accordance with LRFD 3.8.1.2.3b .
